entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The largest fortified city on Innistrad in the province of Gavony, primary religious, administrative and military center for humanity and seat of the Church of Avacyn.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane on which Thraben stands.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church seated in Thraben and led by the Lunarch.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: Council that oversees church leadership; withdrew to Ollenback after the sieges.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: Main fortress-cathedral of the church, destroyed in the Battle of Thraben.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel whose absence enabled the siege and who was later corrupted and destroyed by Sorin in the cathedral.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Avacyn's creator who destroyed her.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Necromancer who besieged Thraben, was imprisoned by Odric, and later took control of the city's zombies as self-proclaimed Queen of Thraben.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Necromancer brother of Gisa who infiltrated Thraben to kill Mikaeus.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: Lunarch killed by Geralf and raised as a zombie by Liliana.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who raised Mikaeus, caused the Sundering of the Helvault and brought a zombie army to the Battle of Thraben.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: Champion of the church who captured Gisa and still wages war on zombies.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison whose Sundering freed Avacyn.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose lingering presence corrupted Avacyn and who was imprisoned in Innistrad's Moon.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire leader whose army fought in the Battle of Thraben.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: Leader of Olivia's allied forces in the battle who refuses to abandon the ruined city.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel who killed Brisela, winning the Battle of Thraben.

entities.name: Brisela
entities.description: Eldrazi-corrupted being killed by Sigarda.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker whose cultists fought alongside Emrakul.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Reinforced the coalition in the Battle of Thraben.

entities.name: Wilhelt
entities.description: Zombie-lord rejected by Gisa who besieged Thraben and was defeated.

entities.name: Siege of Thraben
entities.description: Gisa and Geralf's siege of the city in Avacyn's absence.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: Coalition battle against Emrakul's Eldrazi and Nahiri's cultists.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: Faction allied with Olivia in the battle; its cathars keep fighting zombies.

events.summary: In Avacyn's absence, Gisa and Geralf besiege Thraben; Geralf kills Lunarch Mikaeus and Liliana raises him as a zombie.
events.quote: Geralf snuck into the city before the attack to kill Lunarch Mikaeus .

events.summary: Gisa's army breaks the outer wall but is pushed back by fire; Odric captures Gisa.
events.quote: Odric , a champion of the church, captured Gisa and held her imprisoned in Rider's Lock.

events.summary: Liliana causes the Sundering of the Helvault, freeing Avacyn, who casts the Cursemute and creates the Wolfir.
events.quote: Liliana caused the Sundering of the Helvault , and Avacyn was free.

events.summary: Avacyn, corrupted by Emrakul's presence, attacks humanity and is destroyed by her creator Sorin Markov in the Cathedral of Thraben.
events.quote: a final confrontation in the Cathedral of Thraben with her creator, Sorin Markov , who ultimately destroyed her

events.summary: In the Battle of Thraben a coalition of vampires, the Order of Saint Traft, the Gatewatch and zombies defeat Emrakul's Eldrazi and Nahiri's cultists after Sigarda kills Brisela; Emrakul is imprisoned in Innistrad's Moon.
events.quote: Emrakul was imprisoned within Innistrad's Moon

events.summary: After the battle Thraben lies in ruins; Gisa takes control of Liliana's zombies and rejects Wilhelt, who besieges the city and is defeated.
Thalia, Odric and the cathars refuse to abandon the ruined city and keep waging war on the zombies.
events.quote: still wage war on the zombies that prowl the streets

relations.note: Largest fortified city on the plane.
relations.quote: Thraben is the largest fortified city on the plane of Innistrad
Church of Avacyn and its ruling Lunarch Council

relations.note: Destroyed her to prevent further devastation.
Decisive kill in the Battle of Thraben.

relations.quote: the sibling necromancers Gisa and Geralf Cecani

relations.note: Killed him before Liliana raised him as a zombie.
